title: Item Frame Management
description: This mod adds the functionality to click through item frames & reset an item frames rotation.
body:
This mod adds functionality to click through item frames via a toggle (keybind "I" by default), and also the functionaility to reset an items rotation in an item frame by using SHIFT + Middle Click.

**Reset an Items rotation:**
- Use SHIFT + Middle Click and the item will go back to its default rotation

**Click Through Item Frames**
- You can toggle on Click Through by pushing the button "I" (can be rebound in controls). 
- You can normal right click on an item frame to open a container behind it.
- You can shift + right click to edit the item frame.
